Info.Name: zzap 저사양 [테스트]
Info.Description: [테스트] 저사양 PC용. zzap 보통 + 성능 설정(성능 모드 켬, 멀리 있는 봇끼리의 업데이트·시야·청각 제한 켬, 조준선 자리 찾기 범위 축소). 프레임은 조금 나아질 수 있지만, 멀리서 벌어지는 봇끼리의 싸움은 덜 정교해질 수 있음. 의도한 전투 경험과 다를 수 있는 시험용.
Info.Creator: R_F

Movement.Description: Scales vision speed based on the movement speed of their enemy. Faster movement = faster vision speed.

PartsVisibility.Description: Scales vision speed based on the number of body parts that are within line of sight to their enemy. Only applies to Non-AI targets.

Peripheral.Description: Adds additional vision speed reduction to targets in a bot's peripheral vision.Scales with the angle from their look direction.

Pose.Description: Scales vision speed based on the pose of their enemy. Only applies to Non-AI targets.

ThirdParty.Description: When an enemy is a certain angle away from their active enemies last known position, this will reduce their vision speed of that target up to the maximum set amount.

Chad.Name: Chad
Chad.Description: An aggressive player. Typically wearing high tier equipment, and is more aggressive than usual.

Coward.Name: Coward
Coward.Description: A player who is more passive and afraid than usual. Will never seek out enemies and will hide in a closet until the scary thing goes away.

GigaChad.Name: GigaChad
GigaChad.Description: 고인물. 소리 들으면 바로 돌격, 코너 점프·버니합, 교전 중 다이아몬드 스텝.

Rat.Name: Rat
Rat.Description: Scum of Tarkov. Rarely Seeks out enemies, and when they do - they will crab walk all the way there

SnappingTurtle.Name: SnappingTurtle
SnappingTurtle.Description: A player who finds the balance between rat and chad, yin and yang. Will rat you out but can spring out at any moment.

Timmy.Name: Timmy
Timmy.Description: A New Player, terrified of everything.

Wreckless.Name: Wreckless
Wreckless.Description: This personality can only be assigned to Twitch Players and some of the Bosses. Bunny hopping, insta-kills, jumping over corners. They'll do everything to kill you. More Aggressive than Gigachads.
